text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing. I was 
trying to head home early to prepare for 
tomorrow's training, but...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
*munch*... *munch*... *gulp*, Mmm-so good! 
Insane!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Phew! That Meaty Beef Burger was insane~! 
Everything was spilling out of the bun~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"What should I eat next? Kilimanjaro 
fries? Or maybe a jumbo apple pie~?"
choice_data_list: No, shouldn't we head back soon?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? I'm just getting started!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but look! You said "every once in a 
while" is fine, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, those were the words spoken here 
right when I first met her...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: And with that, here I gooo~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since it couldn't be helped, I decided to 
overlook it if it was just a little bit, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! This is that viral thing! "Gifts 
from the Carrot Patch"!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, we can try samples? For real!? Yes 
please!"
choice_data_list: Then once we eat, this time for sure—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ring-ring-ring! Ring-ring-ring!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh! Perfect timing♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ayyy!

text_block_list.name: Helios & Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ayyy!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
If your crush is nearby, you gotta invite 
them! That's just common sense!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, sorry to surprise you. It was 
really sudden, so if it's no good, just 
say the word—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
It's all good, it's all good! First a 
selfie, aaand theeen, a dance battle♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hello, Manager! I've come to hang out~♪

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, Jordan-chan♪ You're more than 
welcome to take this shift, you know~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yep, exactly! Today's my day off~! More 
importantly, you got new stuff in stock, 
didn't you?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'd been totally eyeing it for ages~ It 
was such a must-buy, so..." + "

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I mean, they already put out a new one?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh~~! Buying it~~!! Hey, Trainer, hold 
my bags for a sec!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By the time we finally made it back to the 
academy, the sun had completely set...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Sooooo slooouuuchy and boooored!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Th-This is baaad... I can't take another 
step... What... is this...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Totally...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
*Puh-haaah*... Man, that gave me a scare. 
This used to be a piece of cake for me, 
too...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that caused this? For real? That's 
crazy.
choice_data_list:
Let's make sure we don't overdo it and 
play too hard.

Let's be careful not to play too hard, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh~~~. Guess I just wanna live in the 
moment, you know~...?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Once you become an adult, you can't fool 
around like this, right?
choice_data_list: Saving is the mature thing to do

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
See?! Right? Totally called it~! Adults 
are seriously such a hassle.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Well, if you ever wanna cut loose, just 
say the word! I'm pretty good at that 
kinda stuff, y'know?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, yeah, here it comes~ That whole 
adult, whatchamacallit... 'That kind of 
thing' attitude~."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Life's no hype if you keep acting like 
that, y'know?
choice_data_list: It wasn't all bad, you know.
It's not all bad, you know.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I wonder about that.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I'll just keep dragging you around 
like this. Think of it as anti-aging for 
your spirit, yeah?"
